# Generated store queries with no production caller.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS SEPARATELY. Phase 20.1's reachability guard runs
# x/tools/cmd/deadcode, which by design does NOT report dead functions in
# GENERATED files. internal/store/gen is generated, so the entire store
# layer was a blind spot — and that is exactly where B42 hid: nothing in
# production ever called UpsertSyncSubscription, so no entity was ever
# subscribed to any route and the whole ESI sync engine had nothing to do.
#
# Same contract as allowlist.txt: a new uncalled query fails the guard, and
# so does an entry here that has gained a caller. This file should SHRINK.

# B42 — CLOSED in Phase 20.1.1: UpsertSyncSubscription now has a production
# caller and has been removed from this group. What remains are subscription
# MANAGEMENT surfaces that still have none — an operator cannot snooze,
# disable, or opt a subscription out of caching except by SQL, and nothing
# surfaces recent sync runs. Reconciliation sets `enabled` through
# DisableUnscopedSubscriptions, which is why SetSyncSubscriptionEnabled is
# still unused.
#
# PHASE 20.2: SnoozeSyncSubscription left this group. §5.5 requires a 429 —
# and every deliberate gateway refusal — to snooze the affected subscription
# rather than fail its job, and internal/sync/worker/unavailable.go is now
# that caller. The column had existed since Phase 6 and nothing had ever
# written to it.
ListRecentSyncRuns
SetSyncNoCacheOptIn
SetSyncSubscriptionEnabled

# B24 — §4.9 webhook endpoint configuration surface
CreateWebhookEndpoint
ListWebhookEndpointsForUser
RevokeWebhookEndpoint

# B26 — CLOSED in Phase 20.2 apart from one reader. GetRole, ListPermissions,
# ListEffectivePermissions and SetUserActive all gained production callers
# with the role-management surface (internal/api/v1/admin_roles.go) and the
# PATCH /admin/users/{id} fix. What is left is the one query with no natural
# consumer: nothing in HANGAR looks a user up BY their main character, and
# inventing an endpoint to give it one would be the allowlist wagging the
# codebase.
GetUserByMainCharacterID

# B25 — alert routing, channels and the unknown-type boards
CountAlertTypesByDomain
CreateAlertRoutingRule
GetAlertType
ListAlertChannels
ListAlertEventsForCoalesceKeySince
ListAlertTypes
ListRecentAlertEvents
ListUnparseableCharacterNotifications

# B30 — route handlers that are never dispatched, and their readers
DeleteCharacterFittingsNotIn
GetCalendarEventDetail
GetPlanetColonyDetail
GetStarbaseDetail
ListCorporationProjectContributions

# B35 — TeamSpeak identity linking
GetTeamspeakChallenge

# Platform and entitlement configuration has no surface
CreatePlatform
CreatePlatformGroup
GetPlatform
ListEntitlementRulesForGroup
ListEntitlementRulesForSource
SetEntitlementRuleEnabled
UpsertProvisioningState

# Open-vocabulary boards (Gate 6 surfaces these; no reader is wired)
AcknowledgeOpenVocabularyValue
CountUnacknowledgedOpenVocabulary
GetEsiScope
ListUnacknowledgedOpenVocabulary

# HOUSEKEEPING THAT NEVER RUNS — rows accumulate forever
CountEsiCacheEntries
DeleteExpiredEsiCacheEntries
DeleteExpiredSessions
DeleteStaleReplicas
DeregisterReplica

# Writers whose only producer is a sync handler that is never dispatched
# (B30), or whose live path uses hand-written SQL instead of the generated
# query. UpsertReplicaHeartbeat is the latter: internal/telemetry/replica.go
# issues its own statement because it must first probe to_regclass, so the
# generated twin has never been used.
UpsertAlliance
UpsertCharacterFitting
UpsertCharacterFittingItem
UpsertCharacterIntelEdge
UpsertInsurancePrice
UpsertKillmail
UpsertKillmailAttacker
UpsertKillmailItem
UpsertLocation
UpsertNotificationContact
UpsertReplicaHeartbeat

# B45 — reads app.corporation_role, which has NO production writer anywhere
# and is therefore permanently empty. Phase 20.1.1 moved the acting-character
# elector off it onto app.character_role, which is where ESI's
# GET /characters/{character_id}/roles actually lands. This query is kept
# because /corporations/{id}/roles is a real ESI route HANGAR syncs into that
# table via SyncCorporationRoles — the reader has simply never had a
# legitimate consumer. Its remaining caller is the admin surface that does
# not exist yet.
ListCorporationRoles
